name: IntroDB
description: Fetches intro timestamps from IntroDB for automatic skip intro functionality.
overview: Automatically retrieves intro start/end times from the IntroDB database for TV episodes.

versions.changelog:
## What's new
- Jellyfin 12.2 support (also builds for Jellyfin 10.10, 10.11 and Emby 4.9)
- Uses IntroDB's `/segments` API: **intros, recaps and end credits** for TV episodes **and movies**
- End credits stop where a post-credits scene starts, so skipping credits never skips the scene
- Settings page: segment toggles, library/show scope, skip items with existing segments, on-demand fetch (new items and playback), not-found cache, and removal of IntroDB's own segments
- Automatic rate-limit handling (Retry-After / reset_at, backoff and retries); existing segments are kept when a lookup fails
- Emby: intro and end-credits markers, movies

## Install
Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asportnoy/introdb-plugin/main/manifest.json` under **Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories** (Jellyfin 12.2), or download the zip for your server below.
